briefs.claim_en: Drinking hot water mixed with lemon juice will destroy the coronavirus.
briefs.brief_en: Multiple fact-checking organizations, including AFP (March 12, 2020), FactCheck.org (April 2, 2020), BOOM Fact Check (March 13, 2020), and Snopes.com (March 26, 2020), have debunked claims that drinking hot water with lemon juice can prevent or cure COVID-19. VOA (May 18, 2021) and Samayam Tamil (May 26, 2021) also stated that such claims are false and lack scientific evidence. While lemons are rich in Vitamin C and can boost the immune system, this does not mean they can destroy the coronavirus.
